1.name: At the wind's breath, the blossoms wake
1.desc:
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color> summons a <color=Highlight>Shadow of Xuanling: Unfaltering</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> equal to {0} of Yangyang: Xuanling's ATK. This DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color> Stagnates nearby enemies.
<size=10></size>
<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom</color> and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom</color> are immune to interruption.

2.name: River carries her song away
2.desc:
The DMG dealt by <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall</color>,  <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counterk - Havoc in Bloom</color> is increased by {0}.
<size=10></size>
Every time when Yangyang: Xuanling remains out of combat for more than 4s after she leaves the combat state or regains consciousness, she gains the following effects once:
- Gain <color=Highlight>Strung Notes</color>, up to 1 stack. Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color> or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color> summons <color=Highlight>Shadow of Xuanling: Strung Notes</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> equal to {1} of Yangyang: Xuanling's ATK, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>. <color=Highlight>Strung Notes</color> is removed after <color=Highlight>Shadow of Xuanling: Strung Notes</color> is summoned.
- Restore 2 points of <color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color>.
- Reset the Cooldown of gaining <color=Highlight><te href=161003>Bated Breath</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=161004>Streaming Storm</te></color>.

3.name: My grief follows you into the clouds
3.desc:
The DMG dealt via Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Hush of a Thousand Voices</color> is Amplified by {0}.
<size=10></size>
After casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Skybound Feather</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color>, or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color>, increase the maximum <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> stacks of targets within a certain range by {1}, lasting {2}s. This effect does not stack.
<size=10></size>
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color>, and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color> apply 1 additional stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> to the target.

4.name: Across the miles, a letter and my longing
4.desc: When casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Skybound Feather</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Azure</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Feather</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color>, or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color>, the ATK of Resonators in the team is increased by {0} for {1}s.

5.name: Take wing. Take wing.
5.desc: When Yangyang: Xuanling takes a fatal blow, she will not be downed, but instead recover HP equal to {0} of her Max HP while becoming immune to DMG and interruption for {1}s. This effect can be triggered once every {2} min.

6.name: Let the azure keep its light
6.desc:
When Yangyang: Xuanling applies <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> to a target, gain <color=Highlight>Voice Flux</color> for {0}s. While <color=Highlight>Voice Flux</color> is active, the Heavy Attack DMG from Yangyang: Xuanling is increased by {1}.
<size=10></size>
After casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color>, gain <color=Highlight>Still as Withered Wood</color> for {2}s. While <color=Highlight>Still as Withered Wood</color> is active, if Yangyang: Xuanling is on the field, then when nearby Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color>, <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>, <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color>, <color=Highlight><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color>, <color=Highlight><te href=850008>Spectro Frazzle</te></color>, or <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color>, Yangyang: Xuanling summons <color=Highlight>Shadow of Xuanling: Still as Withered Wood</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> equal to {3} of Yangyang: Xuanling's ATK. The DMG of <color=Highlight>Shadow of Xuanling: Still as Withered Wood</color> is considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color> and is guranteed to be a critical hit.
<size=10></size>
<color=Highlight>Shadow of Xuanling: Still as Withered Wood</color> can be summoned once every {4}s and expires after being summoned {5} times. When <color=Highlight>Still as Withered Wood</color> expires or is removed, reset the available summon charges of <color=Highlight>Shadow of Xuanling: Still as Withered Wood</color>. <color=Highlight>Still as Withered Wood</color> has a Cooldown of {6}s.

81001610.name: Yangyang: Xuanling
81001610.bg_description:
Her attire as the "Votary of the Voice," worn after deepening her bond with the Streams.
The bird has shed its down and rides the wind toward the heights. From here on, too, she will stride forward, toward everything she believes in.
